Separate Codex checker decisions bound to exact draft and evidence hashes.

Assessed all 12 selected health_admin notice leads. Three notices specify record writing/reception, referral and document handling, or medical documentation; the other nine provide only a role, qualification, or no task. None supplies a working AI product or sufficiently bounded safe workflow. These paid vacancies establish human work only, not demand for an AI service. Scores remain below 6, so no post is proposed.
